messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout v3.14.0 -> target group 'serving-eu' at 5% traffic. rollout_id=r-321000. change-window 2026-03-23T02:00Z-03:00Z.
alex: quick check — are release notes published and linked to the customer-facing doc?
release-bot: Release notes published: https://release.redwood.com/3.14 • highlights: kv-cache stability fix, batching tweak, embed route retry improvements.
maya: watching perf dashboard (eu). will report anomalies in ~2m.
jamal: seeing tail latency increase on a small subset of canaries: 95p went 120ms -> 240ms around 02:03Z. not across entire cohort yet. collecting logs.
maya: logs show a spike in kvcache misses and a prefix mismatch on ~3 instances. looks like config rollout mismatch.
priya: can we do a partial pin to older version in the region while we triage? ops command for region pin?
alex: PM ok to extend change window by 30m if needed. prefer partial rollback to avoid user impact.
maya: recommend throttling down to 2% and run extra smoke tests while we validate the cache behavior. command: `deployctl adjust --id r-321000 --percent 2`
jamal: +1. re-running synthetic probes (embed and chat flows) and will watch error budgets for 15m. paging thresholds unchanged.
deploy-bot: Adjusting rollout r-321000: target percent -> 2%... done.
release-bot: Deploy history note: us-east-1 canary at 5% passed earlier today. eu shows regression signal.
maya: smoke tests after throttle: 9/10 passing, 1 instance returning 502s on /v1/embeddings. stacktrace points to memory pressure while restoring kvcache.
jamal: investigating memory spikes. could be amplification when cache warmup coincides with batch spikes.
maya: safe mitigation: pin eu-west-1 back to v3.13 while we push a cache hotfix. pin command: `releasectl pin --region eu-west-1 --version v3.13`
priya: I vote for partial pin for eu-west-1 only. we avoid global rollback and keep momentum elsewhere.
alex: product approves partial pin. please add a one-line customer-facing note: "partial rollback in eu-west-1 to v3.13 due to cache warmup regression; global rollout continues at reduced rate."
jamal: alerting rule updated: page if embed 5xx > 0.5% for 10m. I'm standing by.
maya: applying pin now.
deploy-bot: releasectl: pin applied for region eu-west-1 -> v3.13. rollback enacted.
priya: I'll post an update to #release-notes and notify support with the canned blurb.
alex: final decision for now: continue global staged rollout at 2% for 30m while fix is prepared. if metrics remain stable, lift to 10%. if errors creep past threshold, we'll abort and expand pin.
jamal: monitoring dashboards and alerting. will escalate if we hit >0.5% errors.
maya: thanks team — smoke passed post-pin. keeping watch. :thumbsup:
priya: tagging follow-up: create a short post-mortem if we need region pinning and document the rollout config validation step.
alex: noted. thanks all.
